head.text: WF-021: ULPI transmit and receive turnaround, TX CMD aborted by dir (IF-002, success and error)

foot.text: TX CMD with PID, data on nxt, stp one cycle. dir rises (cycle 8): the PHY drives RX CMD and data. A second TX CMD (cycle 15) is aborted when dir rises (cycle 17): the link releases the bus at once.
